text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooooohhh! There are tons of fun-looking 
things here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Look at this frog toy! It's all slimy, 
just like a real one!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This pen gives you an electric shock if 
you touch it! The ghost mask looks great 
for scaring people too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmmghhh... I can't decide which one to 
pick...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
At times like that, you just gotta buy 
everything—!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Shi-shi-shi! With this much, I can 
surprise the whole academy!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? I feel like I'm forgetting 
something...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I bought everything I wanted, so... 
Uuuum...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's fine! More importantly, it's 
time to prep the prank!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy completely forgot about 
training and became totally absorbed in 
setting up pranks all over the academy.
